leadText:
A Sailor (Japanese: ふなのり Sailor) is a type of Pokémon Trainer that debuted in the Generation I . Originally they were often depicted as burly men in sailor suits flexing their muscles, though their actual physical shape varies between games. The sailor is one of two minor trainer classes, the other being , whose design features a visible tattoo. The Generation I sprites have an anchor tattoo and the model has “FeeL GooD” tattooed across the knuckles reminiscent of "Hold Fast" tattoos. In as well as in , a sailor named Eldritch plays a minor part in the game's storyline.

They usually specialize in Pokémon, with the exception of using and the evolutionary line.

In , Sailors battled outside of Gyms will award three s along with prize money upon being defeated.

In Tentacool & Tentacruel, and 's Pokémon rescued a Sailor.

In Mantine Overboard, a Sailor gave Ash and information about the ferry they missed.

In Hoenn Alone!, a with the exact same design helped battle . He was called a captain in the English dub.

In Island Time, a Sailor and a ship captain found Ash and after they escaped Wailmer Island.

In Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!, a Sailor helped the of the ship Ash and his friends were riding on investigate Mrs. Ripple's lost jewel. He did this by interrogating Mr. Shaw.

In A Glaring Rivalry!, a Sailor had a against and his , but they lost.

In Crowning the Chow Crusher!, a Sailor was among the competitors in the Pokémon Grand Eating Contest. Though he managed to get past the first round, his was unable to continue due to feeding it tampered cookies that filled up its stomach.

====History====
===== =====
In Danger: High Voltorb, a group of Sailors are the S.S. Anne's guards. They are seen carrying boxes to the ship.

==== ====
 
Sailor Eldritch appears in this chapter, being one of the many sailors to work on the S.S. Aqua. In the , he was revealed to have become a captain of the S.S. Sinnoh.

===== =====
In Now You See Me..., a Sailor was seen in command of the Seagallop Ferry. He would be seen frequently during the arc, transporting the Kanto Pokédex holders from island to island.

===== =====
In Epilogue, multiple Sailors makes a cameo by appearing in the S.S. Sinnoh which is heading to the .

===== =====
A Sailor was one of the people swarming the Mossdeep Space Center in Diancie Shines.

===== =====
In Crafty Carnivine and Floatzel and Jetsam, Sailors are seen in the Pastoria Gym. In the latter chapter, Crasher Wake orders the Sailors to dive in the water of Pastoria Gym to save from drowning, but it turns out she left the water by herself without needing their help.

Multiple Sailors aboard the S.S. Sinnoh were shown to be taken out by a wild in Grumpy Gliscor. In Vexing Vespiquen & Unmanageable Mothim II, those same Sailors witnessed the hatching of the Pokémon Egg found on Iron Island alongside Eldritch.

===== =====
A Sailor briefly appeared in the in Clobbering Claydol as was searching for .

====Pokémon====
 

===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!===
In The Legendary Pokémon Captured, a Sailor tells Byron, Hareta, and Riley about an explosion that went on at Lake Valor.

==Trivia==
In Pokémon XD: Gale of Darkness, Sailors have that say "FEEL GOOD".
